subject: general
question: What is the full form of NABARD?

options.text: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
National Bank for Agriculture and Regional Development
National Agriculture Bank Authority for Rural Development

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development** (NABARD) is an apex development financial institution in India.
 
• It was established on **12 July 1982** by a special act of the Parliament.
 
• NABARD is responsible for the development of the **small industries, cottage industries, and any other such village or rural projects.**
 
• The organization provides **financial support** and **policy guidance** to various institutions in the rural sector.
 
• NABARD also plays a crucial role in **implementing government schemes and initiatives** aimed at rural development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The establishment of NABARD was recommended by the **B. Sivaraman Committee** (Committee to Review Arrangements for Institutional Credit for Agriculture and Rural Development).
 
• NABARD's headquarters is located in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
 
• The institution also focuses on **innovation and technology** in agriculture, promoting sustainable and inclusive growth.
 
• NABARD's initiatives include **microfinance, financial inclusion, and capacity building** programs for rural communities.
 
• It also supports **agricultural research and development** to enhance productivity and efficiency in the sector.
